scope: Lines put one at a time in front of a working replaced mesh's draw (scripts/check_dx11_judge_draws.py --sweep): `expect` is what the comparison with the original gives now, `finding` why a line differs, `class` whose difference it is: `layer` (the plan path differs from the original) or `scene` (the layer's side of this scene lacks what answers the line in a character generation, so the line is not judged here).
